clean-app-roots.description: All target roots (app/, components/, hooks/, screens/) free of convex/react imports after rewrites
records: grep for `convex/react` across app/components/hooks/screens returns 0 hits

app-with-stray-import.description: A clone of the app roots with one deliberately injected `from 'convex/react'` import line (negative control)
records: exactly 1 `convex/react` import line present in a scanned root

requirements.description: GIVEN: the command exists WHEN: the operator runs `holo verify:no-convex-client` THEN: it scans app/, components/, hooks/, screens/ for `convex/react` imports and reports the roots covered

must_observe: command reports `4` scanned roots (app, components, hooks, screens)
exit code `0` on a clean tree
must_not_observe: a silent no-op command (`0` roots reported)

requirements.description: GIVEN: a stray `from 'convex/react'` import is present in a scanned root WHEN: the operator runs the gate THEN: it exits non-zero naming the offending file and line
requirements.verify: services/platform/src/cli/commands/__tests__/verify-no-convex-client.test.ts (seed a stray import, assert non-zero exit + file:line)

steps: inject one `import { useQuery } from 'convex/react'` line into a scanned root

must_not_observe: exit code `0` (gate passed a stray import — un-fakeable failure)
a generic error with `0` file:line detail

requirements.description: GIVEN: a PR touches app/ WHEN: CI runs the gate THEN: the gate runs as a required check on PRs touching app/ and blocks merge on failure

must_observe: the step is a `required` gating check
must_not_observe: the gate absent from the workflow (`0` steps)
